part.text:
The robot reached the end of the corridor and is now resting about 0.8 m in front of the green panel, facing it. The panel fills the camera view.

How it got there:
- **First stretch:** It walked about 3.5 m down the corridor. Collision protection stopped it a few times because it kept drifting toward the right wall, so I moved it left and turned it slightly to straighten up.
- **Left turn:** At the end of that stretch the corridor turns left. A look to the sides showed the green panel down that way, so I turned the robot about 95° left.
- **Second stretch:** It walked about 3.5 m more toward the panel. It drifted toward the right wall again and was stopped once, so I made the same kind of correction, then walked the last 1.3 m.

It didn't fall at any point.
